class.name: NNFloatRangeSensor
class.brief_description: Accepts a minimum and maximum value that defines a value range. The input value given is scaled to 0..1 range within the given min and max values.
class.description: Normalises [member range_value] linearly across the interval from [member range_min_value] ([code]0.0[/code]) to [member range_max_value] ([code]1.0[/code]) when evaluated, clamping the resulting [member NNSensors.sensor_value] to [code]0.0..1.0[/code]. If [member range_min_value] is greater than or equal to [member range_max_value] (equal or reversed bounds), or the span is non-finite, [member NNSensors.sensor_value] evaluates to [code]0.0[/code].

members.member: The maximum value for the range.
The minimum value for the range.
Input value for the sensor. Assignments outside [member range_min_value] and [member range_max_value] are immediately clamped to those bounds.
